sourcePolicy: All questions in this pack are Ready2Go original draft practice items unless an individual record states otherwise. No official JAMB past-question corpus is included. Human subject-matter and answer-key review is required before public release.

questions.question: What does “Na gode” mean?
questions.explanation: Na gode is a common Hausa expression for thank you.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: “Ina kwana?” is commonly used to ask what?

options.C: How was the night / good morning?

questions.explanation: Ina kwana is a morning greeting.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: “Sannu” is often used as what?

options.B: A greeting or expression of goodwill

questions.explanation: Sannu is a common greeting or polite expression.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which Hausa word means “water”?
questions.explanation: Ruwa means water.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which word means “house”?
questions.explanation: Gida means house.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which word means “book”?
questions.explanation: Littafi means book.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which word means “school”?
questions.explanation: Makaranta means school.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: “Rana” commonly means what?
questions.explanation: Rana can mean sun or day depending on context.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: “Abinci” means what?
questions.explanation: Abinci means food.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which phrase means “good morning” in common Hausa usage?
questions.explanation: Ina kwana is a common morning greeting.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: “Babu komai” is commonly used to mean what in response to thanks?

options.B: You are welcome / it is nothing

questions.explanation: Babu komai can mean you are welcome or it is nothing.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which word means “person”?
questions.explanation: Mutum means person.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: “Yaro” generally means what?
questions.explanation: Yaro commonly refers to a boy or child.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: “Kofa” means what?
questions.explanation: Kofa means door.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: “Sai anjima” is generally used to mean what?
questions.explanation: Sai anjima is a farewell meaning see you later.
